title: Plugin Context Contract
desc: How plugins reach Studio services without importing app persistence.
lede: Plugins get what they need through a context object — never by importing Studio's internals.
body:
In progress — the context contract is being finalized in Phase 12.
At a glance
  • plugin/core stays portable (no app imports).
  • A context is passed into Studio-facing adapters.
  • Persistence stays Studio-owned.

Why portability matters

The engine core must run without Studio. Keeping it free of app imports is what lets engines be extracted and run standalone — see Portable Core & Standalone Repos.

The context

Studio passes a context into the plugin's adapter layer for the services it's allowed to use. Studio still owns persistence and state.
